g10-economics-ue6-t1.overview: Review of Macroeconomic Variables sits inside Economic Growth. Economic growth is the focus of Unit 6 of Grade 10 Economics in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it reviews the macroeconomic variables behind growth. Then it defines and measures economic growth, and separates it from economic development. Next, it examines the sources of growth, above all productivity. Also it weighs the limits of GDP per capita as a measure. Finally, it walks through the phases of the business cycle. Students will also learn how economic growth shapes real-life living standards.
objectives: Identify the major sources of growth.
Explain the weaknesses of GDP per capita.
g10-economics-ue6-t1.simple:
Review of Macroeconomic Variables in plain words. The exam wants you to recognise the core ideas, not to memorise whole paragraphs. Focus on:
  • First, a review of GDP, GNP, inflation, and unemployment.
  • Also why these variables matter for growth.
g10-economics-ue6-t1.detailed:
Review of Macroeconomic Variables — the essentials. First, a review of GDP, GNP, inflation, and unemployment. Also why these variables matter for growth.

What the MoE expects you to be able to do:

  • Review the main macroeconomic variables.
  • Define and measure economic growth.
  • Distinguish growth from economic development.
  • Identify the major sources of growth.
  • Explain the weaknesses of GDP per capita.
